steps.expected: Section D RT-08: 'Warrens exit -> river -> Tether Relay | -> (350,3760)'. `band2_outrider_kest` stands at (0,2980) on this leg
steps.observation: W21-HARNESS-FIGHTS-0904, CL-H2's measured root cause. `close_enough` was 5.0 m, but `scripts/npc/npc_body.gd::add_prompt()` gives every NPC a 3.8 m prompt radius -- so a walk allowed to stop 4-5 m out arrives with NO live prompt and the challenge press lands on nothing. Measured directly on this branch: gate-f-run-W21-S07 walked 509.4 m to (0,2980), stopped 4.1 m out inside the old 5.0 m tolerance, and `S07-19` refused with 'no narrative modal is open. input_context is world and the input owner is nothing' -- which the OLD `press interact, times: 10` would have reported as ten green presses into empty world, followed by thirty green combat_quick presses into a fight that never started. The WAYPOINT IS UNCHANGED; only the arrival tolerance is tightened to 3.5 m, the value the identical approach at Dorn (S06-17) and at the outer watch (S09-23) already uses and that both proved on this branch by opening their conversations on the first press. Previous observation kept: answer_prompts turned ON for this journey walk. TRADE RECORDED EXPLICITLY: the schema says this flag must stay off in any segment whose subject is whether something blocks travel, so these segments can no longer evidence 'a narrative modal blocked the player from travelling'. That finding is already captured in full, un-answered, in S02-superseded-2/3/4 and S02/BLOCKER.md -- three press counts, identical 7201-frame holds. What it buys is everything downstream: measured in S03 and S04, an unanswered modal at a walk's end left input_context='narrative_modal' where the next step expected combat, so no fight started, no catch resolved, the team never reached three, and every tournament entry check then failed on team size. Without this the journey produces no combat, catching, building or progression evidence at all.

steps.observation: N10-HARNESS-TESTS-0905, brief item 9. WAS a bare `press interact`. `interact_with` presses only when the interaction arbiter has a LIVE prompt and only when that prompt's own text is the one this step means -- `trainer_npc.gd::_prompt_for` builds it from data/config/trainers.json's `challenge` template, "Challenge %s" -- and otherwise FAILs naming what it actually saw and how far the intended entity is. A bare press cannot tell a live challenge offer from no offer at all, which is how S08-27 reported a green press into an unengaged world and cost two lanes a run each to diagnose. check_provider false: the prompt belongs to a prompt child of the NPC, and matching on the text the player reads is the stronger check.

steps.observation: G3-BAND3-0903, harness defect found and fixed. This step was a fixed `combat_quick x32` press block with no swap-safety net, unlike Vance's own multi-block sequence below. Traced in a real run's telemetry (ralph/reports/G3-BAND3-0903/gate-f-s07/): the 32-press budget ran out with Hess's second creature (Mudsnout) still alive at roughly 11 HP, combat never formally ended, `input_context` never returned to `world`, and every step from S07-34 (walking to Orrin) onward executed against a player still frozen in that same stuck fight for the rest of the run -- the whole five-creature party was ground down to 0 HP with no further attack input ever sent. `operator_harness.gd::_step_fight` already exists for exactly this (`until_flag` + an HP-gated `party_cycle` handover) and was simply never adopted for this trainer; switched to it rather than guessing a larger fixed count that could still run out against an unlucky roll.

steps.expected: the charged verb's hold edge
steps.observation: G3-BAND3-0903, REAL SHIPPED BUG FOUND (project.godot InputMap, not this segment, not this band's data): `combat_charged` and `build_shortcut` are BOTH bound to the identical physical input, JoyAxis:4 at axis_value 1.0 -- a player holding the left trigger for a charged attack on a controller also fires the Build shortcut. Reproduced in two full real runs of this exact step at the default (joypad) device: the instant the press landed, `input_context` flipped to `build_catalogue` and never returned, stranding every step for the rest of the segment (rescue the captive, disable the relay, restore the crossing, save) behind a menu nothing in the script ever closes. `device: "mouse"` routes this ONE step through `combat_charged`'s own separate mouse-button binding (button_index 2, which `build_shortcut` does not share) so this segment's own evidence is not lost to a bug outside Band 3's file ownership -- it does not fix the underlying collision, which needs an owner/input decision (rebind one of the two actions off JoyAxis:4) and is reported, not silently patched, in ralph/reports/G3-BAND3-0903/REPORT.md. Any OTHER segment that presses `combat_charged` on the default joypad device is still exposed and is not this edit's to chase.
